notes.title: Souls Survivors: Next Fest Livestream 2
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

The second stream will be broadcast on Feb 6th @ 7 PM PST!

You can watch the stream on the Steam Next Fest page at that time. The stream is pre-recorded and will be looped throughout the duration of Steam Next Fest on our store page.

If you haven't had a chance yet, make sure to play our free demo! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708898/0ccbae7ca2551b9142d351ff25e51492cffeca9f.png[/img]

Don't forget to wishlist the game and share your feedback and thoughts with us either through [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2633560/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url]

Thank you so much for your support.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2633560/Souls_Survivors/
